from urllib.request import urlopen
from zipfile import ZipFile
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,hashlib
with urlopen('https://pypi.org/pypi/jawa/json') as r: metadata=json.load(r)
wheel=next(item for item in metadata['urls'] if item['packagetype']=='bdist_wheel')
with urlopen(wheel['url']) as r: data=r.read()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==wheel['digests']['sha256']
with ZipFile(BytesIO(data)) as z: z.extractall('.tmp/chunk-audit/python')
sys.path.insert(0,'.tmp/chunk-audit/python')
from jawa.cf import ClassFile
p='.tmp/chunk-audit/client.jar'
assert hashlib.sha1(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='e877b6a07acd633fb3bb475002175cec036e7b87'
with ZipFile(p) as z, Path('.tmp/chunk-audit/disassembly.txt').open('w') as out:
 for name in ['net/minecraft/server/level/ChunkTrackingView.class','net/minecraft/server/level/ChunkTrackingView"'$Positioned.class'"']:
  cf=ClassFile(BytesIO(z.read(name)));print('\\nCLASS',name,file=out)
  for method in cf.methods:
   print('METHOD',method.name.value,method.descriptor.value,file=out)
   if method.code:
    for ins in method.code.disassemble():
     print(ins.pos,ins.mnemonic,ins.operands,file=out)
     if ins.mnemonic.startswith(('invoke','get','put')):
      for op in ins.operands:
       try:print('  ',cf.constants.get(op.value),file=out)
       except:pass
print('Read-only Python disassembly saved.')
PY

	@Override
	public int waitForChunksRender(boolean waitForDownload, int timeout) {
		ThreadingImpl.checkOnGametestThread("waitForChunksRender");

		return context.waitFor(client -> (!waitForDownload || areChunksLoaded(client)) && areChunksRendered(client), timeout);
	}

	private static boolean areChunksLoaded(Minecraft client) {
		int renderDistance = client.options.getEffectiveRenderDistance();
		ClientLevel level = Objects.requireNonNull(client.level);
		ClientChunkCache.Storage chunks = ((ClientChunkCacheAccessor) level.getChunkSource()).getStorage();
		ClientChunkCacheStorageAccessor chunksAccessor = (ClientChunkCacheStorageAccessor) (Object) chunks;
		int viewCenterX = chunksAccessor.getViewCenterX();
		int viewCenterZ = chunksAccessor.getViewCenterZ();

		for (int dz = -renderDistance; dz <= renderDistance; dz++) {
			for (int dx = -renderDistance; dx <= renderDistance; dx++) {
				if (level.getChunk(viewCenterX + dx, viewCenterZ + dz, ChunkStatus.FULL, false) == null) {
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		return true;
	}

	private static boolean areChunksRendered(Minecraft client) {
		ClientLevel level = Objects.requireNonNull(client.level);
		return ((ClientLevelAccessor) level).getLightUpdateQueue().isEmpty() && client.levelRenderer.hasRenderedAllSections();
	}

item.text:
The evidence points to the test’s download check. Minecraft 26.3 streams a rounded chunk area, but Fabric’s helper waits for a full square. At radius 8, vanilla excludes exactly the four reported corners, even though rendering is complete. At the helper’s default radius 5, the shapes don’t conflict.

I verified this in the official client bytecode using Python; no Java ran locally. I’ll keep the radius-8 tour, require every chunk in the server’s actual tracking view to arrive, then require rendering to finish.
